**Route at a glance:** La Paz – Uyuni – Tahua – Siloli Desert – Laguna Verde – Uyuni – Rurrenabaque – San Miguel del Bala – Madidi National Park – La Paz – Copacabana – Isla del Sol – La Paz  

This route takes you through several very different landscapes in Bolivia: high-altitude La Paz, the Uyuni salt flat, Tahua, the Siloli Desert and the lagoons of the Eduardo Avaroa National Reserve, followed by the Amazon and Lake Titicaca.

In La Paz, you’ll explore markets, see Baroque architecture and ride the city’s cable car. Around Uyuni, you’ll see the Train Cemetery, Incahuasi Island, volcanic landscapes and colourful lagoons. In Madidi, the focus shifts to boat trips, walking trails, the rainforest after dark and watching birds and other wildlife. At Lake Titicaca, you’ll visit Copacabana and Isla del Sol, where Inca archaeological sites survive.

Expect frequent flights and transfers, with a complete change of scenery every day or two. From high-altitude La Paz and the dry landscapes of Uyuni, you descend to the warm rivers and thick greenery of the Amazon. Then you climb back to the cool air of the Altiplano and the blue waters of Lake Titicaca. These shifts in climate and scenery give the trip much of its variety.
